references.title: Better Informed Distance Geometry: Using What We Know To Improve Conformation Generation
Improving Conformer Generation for Small Rings and Macrocycles Based on Distance Geometry and Experimental Torsional-Angle Preferences
A Branch‐and‐Prune algorithm for the Molecular Distance Geometry Problem
references.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>
                    The Molecular Distance Geometry Problem consists in finding the positions in
                    <jats:inline-graphic xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink" xlink:href="graphic/ITOR_622_mu8.gif" xlink:title="inline image"/>
                    of the atoms of a molecule, given some of the inter‐atomic distances. We show that under an additional requirement on the given distances this can be transformed to a combinatorial problem. We propose a Branch‐and‐Prune algorithm for the solution of this problem and report on very promising computational results.
                  </jats:p>
